learningObjective.zh: 學習及練習與 PUSH 有關的片語動詞。
learningObjective.en: Learn and practise the phrasal verbs related to PUSH.

register.labelZh: PUSH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: push ahead、push forward 和 push on 可以表示個人、團隊或機構即使遇到困難,仍然繼續工作或前進。；PUSH 片語動詞可以描述欺負別人、把工作強加給別人、排擠某人,或逼使某人作出決定。；push forward、push past、push through 和 push in 能表達在人群、隊伍和狹窄地方中的不同移動方式。；push towards 可以表示朝目標推進;push something up 則可以解釋價格、數字或水平上升的原因。
register.summaryEn: Push ahead, push forward and push on can show that a person, team or organisation continues working or travelling even when the situation is difficult. The PUSH family can describe bullying, forcing unwanted work onto somebody, excluding people or pressuring them towards a decision. Push forward, push past, push through and push in help speakers describe different kinds of movement in crowds, queues and narrow places. Push towards can describe progress towards a goal, while push something up can explain why prices, numbers or other levels increase.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；部分形式看來相似,但意思不同。請仔細閱讀整個情境。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: push him around push her away push it back push them out push it up Some forms look similar but have different meanings: push on with the work = continue the work push on to the village = continue the journey push forward with the plan = continue the plan push forward through the crowd = move forwards through the crowd

comparisons.titleZh: 表達克服困難後繼續前進
comparisons.zh: push ahead、push forward 和 push on 可以表示個人、團隊或機構即使遇到困難,仍然繼續工作或前進。
comparisons.en: Push ahead, push forward and push on can show that a person, team or organisation continues working or travelling even when the situation is difficult.

examples.en: The school pushed ahead with the new programme.
examples.zh: 學校繼續推進新計劃。

comparisons.titleZh: 描述壓力、控制和不公平對待
comparisons.titleEn: Describe pressure, control and unfair treatment
comparisons.zh: PUSH 片語動詞可以描述欺負別人、把工作強加給別人、排擠某人,或逼使某人作出決定。
comparisons.en: The PUSH family can describe bullying, forcing unwanted work onto somebody, excluding people or pressuring them towards a decision.

examples.en: Do not let other people push you around.
examples.zh: 不要讓其他人欺負或控制你。

comparisons.titleZh: 描述人群和狹窄地方中的移動
comparisons.zh: push forward、push past、push through 和 push in 能表達在人群、隊伍和狹窄地方中的不同移動方式。
comparisons.en: Push forward, push past, push through and push in help speakers describe different kinds of movement in crowds, queues and narrow places.

examples.en: He tried to help, but she pushed him away.
examples.zh: 他嘗試幫忙,但她拒絕了他的接近。

comparisons.zh: push towards 可以表示朝目標推進;push something up 則可以解釋價格、數字或水平上升的原因。
comparisons.en: Push towards can describe progress towards a goal, while push something up can explain why prices, numbers or other levels increase.

examples.en: The police pushed the crowd back.
